title: Sohbet Hayatta Kalma
goalTr: Sohbet başlat, hızlı tepki ver, anlamadığında kurtar — asla donma. Ana beceri: AÇ → TEPKİ VER → SORU SOR.

chunks.use: Selamlaşma — 'How are you?'un doğal hali. Kısa cevap: 'Pretty good, you?'
chunks.ex: How's it going? — Pretty good! You?
How are you finding Bali so far? — I love it, honestly.
What brings you to Bali? — Mostly a holiday.

chunks.en: How long are you here for?
chunks.ex: How long are you here for? — About a week.

chunks.en: Is this your first time here?
What have you done so far?
chunks.use: 'so far' = şu ana kadar — çok sık kullanılır.

chunks.en: What are you up to today?
chunks.use: 'up to' = yapmak (günlük konuşma). Cevap: 'Not much, probably the beach.'

chunks.ex: I slept at the airport. — No way! What happened?

chunks.use: Her cevabın sonuna ekle — sohbeti geri paslar.

chunks.ex: Sorry, I didn't catch that. — No worries, I said...

chunks.en: Could you speak a little slower?
How do you say ___ in English?
chunks.ex: How do you say 'kumsal' in English? — Beach!

chunks.en: I know what I mean, I just don't know the word.
chunks.tr: Ne demek istediğimi biliyorum ama kelimeyi bilmiyorum.
chunks.use: Kurtarma — insanlar sana yardım eder, sohbet devam eder.

quick.sample: I'm from Turkey — from Istanbul, actually.
Pretty good! A bit tired, but good. You?

quick.q: Is this your first time in Bali?

quick.q: How are you finding Bali so far?

quick.q: What have you done so far?
quick.sample: Honestly, I've just been walking around.

quick.q: Sorry, what was your name again?

social.stmt: I missed my flight and had to sleep at the airport.
samples: That's rough. How long were you stuck there?

social.stmt: I've been traveling for six months.
samples: That's amazing! Where have you been?
Six months? That's crazy. Don't you miss home?

social.stmt: This is my fifth time in Bali.
samples: Wow, you must really love it here.
Fifth time? What keeps bringing you back?
Oh nice — what part of Australia?
Cool! Is this close to home for you?
How long have you been traveling?
Oh cool — what do you usually shoot?
How did you get into that?
Do you travel a lot for work?

I've been in Bali for two weeks.
samples: Nice! I just got here. What's been your favorite place so far?

samples: Oh cool! I haven't been to one yet. Which one are you going to?
Haha, yeah. I noticed that today. Is it always like this?

grammar.title: Soru kalıpları: Do / Are / Have / Did

intro.ex: Have you been to Uluwatu? (deneyim — hiç)
Did you go out last night? (geçmiş, belirli zaman)

drills.best: Did you go out last night?

listening.audio: What've you been up to today?
Sorry, I didn't quite catch that.

scenario.title: Kahvaltıda Tanışma
scenario.situationTr: Otel kahvaltısında yalnız oturuyorsun. Bir gezgin masana geliyor. Amaç: donmadan sohbeti karşılıklı akıtmak.
scenario.goalTr: Aç → tepki ver → soru sor. Her cevabının sonuna bir soru eklemeye çalış.

beats.ai: Hey! Mind if I sit here? I'm {name}, by the way.
beats.tr: Selam! Buraya oturabilir miyim? Bu arada ben {name}.
beats.sample: Sure, go ahead! I'm Hakan. Nice to meet you.

beats.ai: Nice to meet you! So where are you from?
beats.sample: I'm from Turkey. What about you?

beats.ai: I'm from {from}. Is this your first time in Bali?
beats.sample: Yeah, I just got here. You?

beats.ai: I've been here for {days} already. Time flies, honestly.
beats.tr: Ben {days} oldu buradayım. Zaman uçuyor cidden.
beats.sample: No way! What have you been doing?

beats.ai: Mostly {doing}. So what brings you to Bali?
beats.tr: Çoğunlukla {doing}. Peki seni Bali'ye getiren ne?
beats.sample: Mostly a holiday — and I wanted to meet people.

beats.ai: Nice. How are you finding it so far?
beats.tr: Güzel. Şu ana kadar nasıl buldun?
beats.sample: I love it so far. It's really relaxed.

beats.ai: Right? Have you been anywhere yet, or did you just get in?
beats.tr: Değil mi? Bir yere gittin mi, yoksa yeni mi geldin?
beats.sample: Just got in, honestly. Any recommendations?

beats.ai: You have to check out {fav}. Easily my favorite spot so far.
beats.sample: Oh nice, I've heard good things about it. Is it far?

beats.ai: Not too far. I'm actually heading to {next} after Bali.
beats.tr: Çok uzak değil. Ben Bali'den sonra {next}'e geçiyorum.
beats.sample: That sounds amazing. How long are you here for?

beats.ai: A few more days. Anyway, I'm gonna grab more coffee. Catch you later?
beats.tr: Birkaç gün daha. Neyse, ben kahve tazeleyeceğim. Sonra görüşür müyüz?
